name: How does finish work integrate with the structural phase of a home addition?

mainEntity.name: How does finish work integrate with the structural phase of a home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Finish work begins after the structural phase of your home addition is complete, meaning the framing, roofing, and rough-ins for plumbing and electrical are in place. This sequence is crucial for process clarity, as it ensures the integrity of the underlying structure before aesthetic elements are added. Any changes or issues during the structural phase can directly affect the start and subsequent flow of finish work, making precise planning essential.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finish work starts after the structural phase, including framing and rough-ins, to ensure a solid foundation for aesthetics.
